test_title: PYST 36: SSC GD Constable 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 29 Feb, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question:
If A + B means A is the wife of B, A × B means A is the father of B, A ÷ B means A is the mother of B, A $ B means A is the brother of B and A - B means A is the sister of B.

If P ÷ D $ B + H × T - M, then how is P related to H?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47a89a5bb9daa01f32d67cf5151f1acc95989e845ae3c3eb86353e0d1da9cbdc.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 +
 -
 ×
 ÷
 $
 
 

 Meaning
 Wife
 Sister
 Father
 Mother
 Brother 
 
 

Given: P ÷ D $ B + H × T - M

It means: P is the mother of D, D is the brother of B, B is the wife of H, H is the father of T and T is the sister of M.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c104adf18dc7ef14378944ba8a58d75a50038a7e970dbddf6234a17727572c18.png] 

So, P is the 'Wife’s mother' of H.

Hence, the correct answer is "Wife’s mother".
